author: SeraphLich
quote: Supposed to be a series where you commit crimes and yet this game dropped discovered your ability to so in this game is the most limited it has EVER been in the francise. I wished the issues stopped there, but it gets worse. This game is basically a poorly written Rated M Sims game with the GTA title slapped on to generate hype. Not sure why people treated this disgrace of an entry like the second coming of Jesus Christ, but  even I who had fair expectations going into the game did not anticipate the level of sheer disappointment I would be faced with. The one and ONLY one compliment I can give is that the graphics are better. Otherwise though I think GTA 5 still reigns superior over GTA 6.
